lines: Rex is doing a Bill of Rights? For dogs? That's so Rex. I'm in.
(Nina signs NINA in big round letters and draws a bone next to it.)
Oh! Hi! You're new, aren't you? I'm Nina!
{player}: Hi, Nina. I'm {player}.
{player}! I like that. Welcome to the Void!
You've got the house just past mine, with the round door. We're neighbours!
If you need anything, I'm usually down by the lake in the morning and at the Skate Park after lunch.
Ooh, you tried it! Did it wobble? It always wobbles.
{player}: I made a bridge and a step in the air!
That's SO good. It's even littler with three of us sharing, but it's still ours. All three of ours.
Bruno says the trick is not to think about it too hard. I say the trick is to think about it LOTS. We're both right, I think.
Go on, try it! Make a bridge in front of you, or jump and make a step under your feet. Three things!
Don't worry if it pops. They always pop. That's the bit that makes Bruno laugh.
Did you find Bruno yet? He's probably at the Skate Park, showing off to a Gloop.
{player}! Okay, okay, I have to tell someone or I'll burst.
Bruno and me found out something. Something BIG. Well, something little. But big!
No, I can't say it. He wants to show you himself. He's been practising all day.
Go and find him. He'll be at the Skate Park, or wherever there's something to skate on.
Bruno made a little bridge over a puddle this morning. It popped halfway. He got very wet. He says it was on purpose.
It's funny. On our own we can't make anything. It only works when there's two of us. Three, now!
Morning, {player}! I'm deciding what to do today.
The lake first, I think. Then skating. Then maybe more skating.
Hi, {player}! Have you been to the Clothing Boutique yet?
They've got butterfly wings now. BUTTERFLY WINGS.
Right?! We should both get some. Then we'd be a team.

choice.text: I'm more of a cape person.
lines: Ooh, a super cape. Very heroic. That suits you.
{player}! Watch this! ...Okay, I'll do the kickflip later. My board needs a rest.
Did you find all the S-K-A-T-E letters? The K is way up high over the quarter pipe.
Try a vert air off the big ramp and go straight up. That's how I got it.
The sky's turning all gold. This is my favourite part of the day.
{player}: Mine too.
See you tomorrow, neighbour!
Hi again, {player}! The Void's even better with a neighbour.
